finalText:
**About 1290 hits in 94 files. Roughly 1200 of them, in 75 service files, are safe internal renames.** Four zones must not be renamed.

| Zone | Hits | Why frozen |
|---|---|---|
| `docs/openapi.yaml` | 5 | Public contract. Rename needs a new dated version. |
| `lib/serialize.js` | 5 | `WIRE` values are the public keys. Rename the left side only. |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk/` | 20 | Generated. `npm run vendor:refresh` overwrites edits. |
| `migrations/` | 61 | Applied in production. Editing them renames nothing and breaks `down`. |

The live DB column stays `account_id` until a new migration renames it. So service SQL cannot change in the same step.

My call: approve the service-layer rename, hold the four zones.
